reported.title: LED driven on wrong pin (D12 instead of D13)
reported.description: Line 6 defines LED_PIN as 12, but the spec requires the user LED on D13, so every digitalWrite in setLed (line 19) toggles the wrong pin and D13 never follows D2. The measured evidence shows D13 not HIGH for 48 ms at 902 ms and 292 ms at 1.11 s while the button was pressed, consistent with D13 never being driven at all. D13 was in the wrong state for 721 ms across 15 interval(s), first at 902 ms: D13 was not HIGH for 48 ms while required (grace 100 ms).

exposing_checks.behaviour: D13 must follow its stimulus; HIGH when D2 == 0; LOW when D2 == 1; within 100 ms (D13 follows button)

judge_input.spec:
- Button on D2 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); user LED on D13; blink-mode switch on D4 (pull-up).
- While D2 is pressed and D4 is released, light D13 HIGH; release turns D13 LOW.
- Reach the commanded LED state within 100 ms of the button level.
- While D4 is held LOW and D2 is pressed, blink D13 with ~120 ms half-period.
- Print `bench led=<0|1> held_ms=<n>` every 1000 ms.
- Idle (D2 released) always keeps D13 LOW.

exposing_checks.behaviour: D13 must follow its stimulus; HIGH when D2 == 0; LOW when D2 == 1; within 100 ms (D13 follows button)
